about: Fixed task set for python -m bench.async_tools (docs/ASYNC-TOOLS.md). Every task needs two or more independent tool calls (bash/read/grep) over the seeded workspace; `check` is applied to the settle answer; `fake` scripts the LLM for --fake (first response: the parallel calls plus bench.async_tools.FAKE_SLOW_CALL; then the answer, after one 'waiting' turn while a call shows [pending] in async mode).
